title: One-time apply of the wider deploy role (the bootstrap exception)
description: The only manual apply: updates the existing humorus-github-deploy stack with the template in Git so the pipeline can deploy. Needs Ryan's go-ahead. Command and permission list are in infra/README.md. After it, every change goes through the pipeline.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Now delivered by Papyrus epic PPY-9bd776 (see HUM-be87f4). Humorus keeps only its stack settings and the one-time seed apply.
